fixes.explanation: That's it. "Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal!" Those are the LORD's words in verse 4, and I think they're startling to hear. He names transgressing and rebelling, with sacrifices every morning and tithes every three days right alongside them. Verse 5 says this is what the children of Israel love to do, and then verse 6 says, "yet you did not return to Me."
